one_liner: CivicState is a Watchlist civic-letter workflow until paid demand and deliverability are proven.
directive: Upgrade the thin soul into an evidence-labeled, operator-gated business plan without claiming investability.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: dispatch brief]; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read existing planning docs and implementation files [evidence: workspace audit]
